coverage_note: The DOIB analogy (friends into identical hotel rooms) and the default-unlabelled rule were readable; the Stirling and partition formulas were past the cut.
concepts: Default-unlabelled rule: if the question names no boxes, groups or teams, the containers are identical - DOIB or IOIB, not DODB or IODB.
'Identical', 'indistinguishable' and 'unlabelled' mean the same thing in question wording.
Partitioning a set = DOIB. Partitioning an integer = IOIB.
